context:
Goal: each rule has one home, and a check, not a reader, catches a copy.
Problem (rule): plan PR #1106 (docs/plans/one-home-check.md) waits on six owner answers in its Input Needed. It now conflicts with main.
Based on (read): its Input Needed lists 1, ban the retired phrase after the fixes; 2, the child exception word `exempt`; 3, a child reads the parent at a pinned sha; 4, a 5-word floor for removed text; 5, whether debt ste-into-agent-briefs closes; 6, paraphrase copies stay a note.
Departs from: main has only the prose rule one-home-per-capability — a check enforces it.

lastAnswer.note: bring me all 6 questions here for me to answer each individually

options.gain: The check gets built; you answer once instead of six times.
options.label: Take the plan's recommendations on 1-4 and 6; the lane reads #1105 and decides 5 (recommended)
options.lose: You accept defaults you have not read one by one.

options.label: Close #1106; the rule stays prose only
options.lose: Copies of a rule keep slipping in unseen.

reply: Split at 12:35 CST into items 337-341, one per question, each yes or no. The plan's question 5 (does debt ste-into-agent-briefs close?) needs no answer: PR #1105 merged on Nov 2 and already closed that debt.
short: Idle PR #1106: the one-home check plan
title: Idle plan PR #1106 (a check that each rule lives in one place): take its six recommendations, or close it?
why: It has sat as a draft since Nov 2, waiting on six answers from you that never reached the page.
